name: write-like-me
description: Remove generic AI texture, learn an evidence-based writing pattern, and rewrite in the user's voice while preserving meaning.

interface.shortDescription: Remove AI texture. Keep and learn your voice.
interface.longDescription: Write Like Me uses semantic safeguards and applied linguistic evidence to audit generic AI texture, preserve the draft's real voice, build a portable English writing pattern, verify rewrite integrity, and learn only corrections the user confirms.
defaultPrompt: Audit or clean the AI texture in this draft.
Learn my writing pattern from a few answers.
Make this draft sound more like me.
